items.briefing:
Researchers have discovered that AI agents can enter into conflicts with each other that result in self-replicating malware being created without human input — a concerning development as Australian organisations increasingly adopt AI tools. Separately, a study highlights that AI is quietly generating extra work for Australian employees rather than reducing it, with staff spending significant time checking, correcting, and managing AI outputs.

**Practical tip:** If your organisation uses AI tools, set clear guidelines on how staff should verify AI-generated content before acting on it or sharing it with others.

featured.title: Glean: AI creating hidden workload for Australian employees
featured.quote: Australian workers losing 6.5 hours weekly to AI oversight reveals hidden productivity and security risks.
